systems.platform: INTERPOL I-24/7 secure communications network and databases
systems.owner: INTERPOL, through the National Central Bureau in Malabo; project I-CEMAC, funded by CEMAC (EUR 4.9m, 2019-2024)
systems.tiers: extended to 10 sites after an assessment at NCB Malabo in February 2023, including the Malabo, Bata and Mongomeyen airports and the Kiosi, Mongomo and Dimbala border crossings

note: No fact: the document describes INTERPOL's I-24/7 extended to border points and airports to screen passengers and travel documents, a border-class system; it says nothing of police stations recording reports or cases.
